items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: my sales letter, Miss Burke, she said, I said, all of you can have anything you want right here in the store.

ctx.x: No, but he is. He's a good-looking.

And I have nothing to be proud of him because he's never given me a day's trouble. What kind of a piano did your brother have in Chicago? A baby grand. A baby grand. A baby grand. A baby grand. I bought my little grandson, uh— Waitel, I think it is. I bought my son's instruments when he was a little boy. And he looked up to that account for my whole— that long time ago, and my sales letter, Miss Burke, she said, I said, all of you can have anything you want right here in the store. So later on, I got this machine…
Well, I was going to ask some more about that visit in Chicago, because that's the longest time that you knew your brother during that year. But you know what?
